projects.title: Public Review Text Classification
bullets: Cleaned public product-review text records for short-document classification during a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Compared classification errors across document lengths using Python, scikit-learn and pandas within the assigned independent-study analysis.

research.title: Question Text Classification Research Assistance
bullets: Implemented a bag-of-words classifier for public question-category text using Python and scikit-learn as a supervised student research assistant.
Documented train and test splits and compared classification errors across document lengths for the supervised short-text classification study.
